summary: Boy Samuel ministering before Eli, word of Yahweh rare, visions not widely known, Eli eyesight dim, lamp of God not yet gone out, Samuel lying in temple where ark of God was, Yahweh calls Samuel, Samuel runs to Eli here I am you called me, Eli says I did not call lie down again, Yahweh calls second time Samuel rises to Eli here I am you called, Eli says I did not call my son lie down again, now Samuel did not yet know Yahweh nor was word revealed. Yahweh calls third time Samuel rises, then Eli perceives Yahweh calls boy, tells go lie down if calls say Speak Yahweh for your servant hears, Samuel goes lies down, Yahweh comes stands and calls as before Samuel Samuel, Samuel says Speak for your servant hears, Yahweh says behold I will do thing in Israel at which two ears tingle, in that day I will perform against Eli all I spoke concerning house from beginning to end, for I have told him I will judge house forever for iniquity which he knew because his sons made themselves vile and he didn't restrain, therefore sworn to house of Eli iniquity shall not be expiated with sacrifice nor offering forever. Samuel lay until morning opened doors, feared to show vision to Eli, Eli calls Samuel my son, don't hide, what word he spoke: please don't hide, God do so to you if you hide anything. Samuel told all didn't hide, Eli says it is Yahweh let him do what seems good. Samuel grew Yahweh was with him let none of his words fall to ground, all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew Samuel established as prophet of Yahweh, Yahweh continued to appear in Shiloh for there Yahweh revealed himself to Samuel by word.
whyItMatters: Call narrative — Samuel hears voice in night, Eli helps discern, Speak Lord servant hears, and first prophecy is difficult judgment against Eli's house, yet Samuel must speak. Establishes Samuel as prophet whose words don't fall to ground.

questions.question: Why does Samuel mistake Yahweh's voice for Eli's three times?
questions.answer: Samuel is boy ministering before Eli, word of Yahweh rare in those days, visions not widely known, and Samuel did not yet know Yahweh nor was word revealed to him. So when hears name Samuel Samuel, assumes Eli calling from nearby where Eli lies eyes dim. Runs to Eli here I am you called me. Eli says I did not call lie down again. Three times pattern important in call narratives — persistence. Eli finally perceives Yahweh calls boy, instructs how to respond: go lie down if calls say Speak Yahweh for servant hears. Shows need for mentor to help discern voice.

questions.question: Why does first prophecy Samuel receives concern Eli's house judgment?
questions.answer: Hard first assignment — word is against Eli: behold I will do thing in Israel at which two ears of everyone who hears will tingle — shocking. Will perform against Eli all I spoke from beginning to end, for he knew sons made themselves vile (cursing) and didn't restrain. Iniquity of Eli's house shall not be expiated with sacrifice nor offering forever. Difficult message for boy to deliver to mentor who raised him. Samuel feared to show vision to Eli, but Eli adjures don't hide, God do so to you if hide. Samuel tells all, Eli responds it is Yahweh let him do what seems good — resignation. Shows prophet must speak difficult truth even to beloved mentor, and establishes Samuel as not just flattering but faithful.

questions.question: What does 'let none of his words fall to ground' mean?
questions.answer: Verse 19: Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to ground — every word Samuel spoke as God's prophet came true, none failed, like arrow hitting target not falling. All Israel from Dan to Beersheba (entire land north to south) knew Samuel established as prophet. Yahweh continued to appear in Shiloh for there Yahweh revealed himself to Samuel by word. Establishes prophetic office after rare word period — word now comes through Samuel.

glossary.term: lamp of God not yet gone out
glossary.def: Night, before dawn, lamp in tabernacle burning, indicating presence still, not extinguished — transition moment.
Samuel did not yet have personal revelation, despite ministering — knowing as intimate encounter not yet.
No word failed — every prophecy came true, effective word.
